WITH counts AS (
  SELECT observstation, COUNT(*) AS telescope_count
  FROM telescopes
  GROUP BY observstation
),
total AS (
  SELECT SUM(telescope_count) AS total_count FROM counts
),
shares AS (
  SELECT c.observstation,
         c.telescope_count,
         CAST(c.telescope_count AS REAL) / t.total_count AS share
  FROM counts c
  CROSS JOIN total t
),
avg_share AS (
  SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM shares
)
SELECT s.observstation,
       s.telescope_count,
       s.share,
       s.share - a.avg_share AS share_diff
FROM shares s
CROSS JOIN avg_share a
ORDER BY share_diff DESC
LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: The set of observatories is those that appear in the telescopes table, so the average share is the mean over those observatories only (observatories with no telescopes are excluded from both the average and the listing).
Share is count divided by the total number of telescope rows, computed as a real-valued fraction (not an integer division or a percentage).

alternatives.interpretation: The average share is taken across all observatories in the observatories table, so observatories with zero telescopes count as share 0 in the average (the listing still covers only observatories that have telescopes).
alternatives.sql:
WITH counts AS (
  SELECT observstation, COUNT(*) AS telescope_count
  FROM telescopes
  GROUP BY observstation
),
total AS (
  SELECT SUM(telescope_count) AS total_count FROM counts
),
shares AS (
  SELECT c.observstation,
         c.telescope_count,
         CAST(c.telescope_count AS REAL) / t.total_count AS share
  FROM counts c
  CROSS JOIN total t
),
avg_share AS (
  SELECT SUM(share) * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM observatories) AS avg_share FROM shares
)
SELECT s.observstation,
       s.telescope_count,
       s.share,
       s.share - a.avg_share AS share_diff
FROM shares s
CROSS JOIN avg_share a
ORDER BY share_diff DESC
LIMIT 10;
